title: 第29章 不用负责的柔雪
content_zh:
第29章 不用负责的柔雪-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“柔雪姐，你可真是我的及时雨啊！”

“这一把猎枪可不少钱嘞，现在不是你欠我人情，是我欠你人情了。”

李青山缓缓将单管猎枪拿了起来，放在手中端详道。

“青山，我能看得出来，你是个好男人。”

“我这些年，一个人也过的难受。”

“今天晚上，我去找你，怎么样？”

“你放心，我不用你负责，以后你要是找到媳妇了，我就不去找你了。”

柔雪咬了咬牙，在有些昏暗的小房间内，终于将自己的心里话讲述了出来。

“柔雪姐，你是认真的吗？”李青山微微一怔，没想到柔雪这个时候会说出这句话来。

“我先走了！”

“这猎枪，你拿走了便是！”

柔雪红了脸，刚刚说出那一番话，早已将勇气全部用完，这个年代保守的姑娘，能够做到这一步，已经十分了不得了。

匆忙离开小房子，便去看自己女儿了。

李青山望着柔雪的背影，心中痒痒难耐，抬头望了一眼天色，可惜还要一段时间才天黑啊！！

将单管猎枪放到盒子里面后。

李青山便将其送回了家，放在自己的房间内藏了起来，然后出门了一趟，去给赵占山看了一眼伤势。

昨日，是因为没有毫针，所以才没办法对赵占山的伤势下手，如今自己有了一套银针，倒是可以去给赵占山缓解一下伤势了。

依旧是那套偏僻的院子内。

在赵占山和赵山杏，一脸不相信的表情中。

李青山第一次给赵占山扎了几针，原本胸口的沉闷和疼痛，竟然真的逐渐在消失了。

这让赵占山的眼神中流露出一抹惊讶之色。

“爹，怎么样了？”赵山杏见自己父亲的表情，连忙问道。

“胸口的气闷和疼痛，好像真的缓解了，没有刚刚那么疼了。”赵占山看向李青山的眼神中，带着三分迷茫，几分震惊。

这小子，什么时候有了这般的手段？

“占山叔！”

“以后，我半个月左右来一次，虽然不能直接帮你治愈，但是却可以帮你缓解一下痛苦，延长寿命，直到能够寻到药引为止！”

李青山将银针收好，自信道。

“青山，你从哪里学的手段？”赵占山依旧在为李青山的手段感觉到震撼道。

平日里，村子里有名的二流子。

怎么突然间，走上正道了？

而且，看起来还很靠谱的样子，这也太让人震惊了。

"Sister Rouxue, you are really my timely rain!"

"This shotgun costs a lot of money. Now you don't owe me a favor, it's me who owes you a favor."

Li Qingshan slowly picked up the single-barreled shotgun, put it in his hand and looked at it carefully.

"Qingshan, I can see that you are a good man."

"I have had a hard time living alone these past few years."

"How about I go find you tonight?"

"Don't worry, I don't need you to be responsible. If you find a wife in the future, I won't look for you."

Rouxue gritted her teeth and finally spoke out her innermost thoughts in the dimly lit small room.

"Sister Rouxue, are you serious?" Li Qingshan was slightly startled, not expecting Rouxue to say this at this time.

"I'm leaving first!"

"You can just take this shotgun!"

Rouxue blushed. She had already used up all her courage when she just said those words. For a conservative girl in this era to be able to do this, it was already extraordinary.

He left the small house in a hurry and went to see his daughter.

Li Qingshan looked at Rouxue's back, feeling itchy in his heart. He raised his head and glanced at the sky. Unfortunately, it would take some time before it gets dark!!

After placing the single barrel shotgun inside the box.

Li Qingshan sent him home, hid him in his room, and then went out to take a look at Zhao Zhanshan's injuries.

Yesterday, there was no way to treat Zhao Zhanshan's injury because he didn't have any needles. Now that he has a set of silver needles, he can relieve Zhao Zhanshan's injuries.

Still in that remote courtyard.

Zhao Zhanshan and Zhao Shanxing had expressions of disbelief on their faces.

Li Qingshan gave Zhao Zhanshan a few injections for the first time, and the dullness and pain in his chest actually gradually disappeared.

This made Zhao Zhanshan's eyes show a hint of surprise.

"Dad, how's it going?" Zhao Shanxing asked quickly when he saw his father's expression.

"The tightness and pain in the chest seem to have really eased. It's not as painful as before." Zhao Zhanshan looked at Li Qingshan with a look that was confused and shocked.

When did this kid have such a method?

"Uncle Zhanshan!"

"From now on, I'll come here about once every half a month. Although I can't help you cure it directly, I can help you relieve your pain and extend your life until you can find a medicine!"

Li Qingshan put the silver needle away and said confidently.

"Qingshan, where did you learn the method?" Zhao Zhanshan said, still shocked by Li Qingshan's method.

On weekdays, he is a well-known second-rate boy in the village.

Why did you suddenly take the right path?

Moreover, it looks very reliable, which is really shocking.
